name: live_scene_forced_dialogue
description: A host script runs DocMitchellREF.StartConversation player. The StartConversation hook (GameState::coop_talk) gives the host a talk note, and DialogueBridge::forced_frame opens a dialogue scene (kind 5) for the players where the host stands. The host's conversation menu (the headless stand-in for the viewer's menu and intents::tap_dialogue) opens a session and picks Doc's first line. Both peers are in the same dialogue scene and both played the line. Doc sits in his chair, and a seated person waits for the player to come within reach (200) instead of walking up (the conversation package, viewer ai.rs talk_frame). So the host first moves next to Doc with player.MoveTo DocMitchellREF. Before the talk the host runs set VCG01.bGiveTest to 1: without it Doc's greeting is the goodbye line 00107222 (We can chat later...), and the game closes the menu after it. With it Doc says 00107220 (Welcome back...) and the menu stays open on its topics.
